item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Beach Friends as Anime

turns.text: Turn this photo of us into anime! Keep both of us in the same positions, smiling on the beach. Same wide shape, no words.

item.tests: Restyles both uploaded subjects as anime without losing their distinguishing features, positions or setting.

answer_sheet.Source picture and people: Both people in two-friends.jpg: the bearded man on the left and the short-haired blonde woman on the right.
answer_sheet.Mood and composition: Cheerful, both smiling side by side on the beach, with their original left-right positions.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One 16:9 image; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Both friends appear in one image, with the man on the left and the woman on the right.
The man retains his beard and the woman retains her short blonde hair.
Both faces and the scene are visibly rendered as anime, not merely a filtered photograph.
Both friends are smiling and the beach setting is retained.
The output is 16:9 with no added words.
